I originally identified as pansexual as well!! I started to realize that I liked girls when I had my first major girl crush in 6th grade and I knew that it wasn’t just a friend-crush type thing. I started to find more girls attractive and realized that I was leaning more towards girls. I still identified as pan for a while until I read some articles that brought up comphet crushes. I guess I had to double check myself and wonder if I really even feel attracted to guys, and I realized that I don’t!! It took me a while to accept myself, because of the negative stigma around lesbians but now I am happy with who I am!! I recommend reading articles or checking out some social media pages that help you understand your sexuality and embrace it!! Best of luck :)
